ar.title: صلصة البطاطس بالثوم

steps.n1: تقطع البطاطس حلقات صغيرة ثم تسلق وتهرس.
steps.n2: نحضر طاسة بها قليل من الزيت حتى يسخن، ثم نضيف الثوم المفري مع الكمون والكسبرة.
steps.n3: نضع البطاطس في طبق التقديم ونسكب عليها التتبيلة مع الملح وقليل من اللبن ويخلطوا جيدا.

en.title: Garlic Potato Sauce

steps.n1: Cut the potatoes into small slices, then boil and mash them.
steps.n2: Prepare a pan with a little oil until hot, then add the minced garlic along with the cumin and coriander.
steps.n3: Place the potatoes in a serving dish, pour the seasoning over them with the salt and a little milk, and mix well.

legacySteps: Cut the potatoes into small slices, then boil and mash them.
Prepare a pan with a little oil until hot, then add the minced garlic along with the cumin and coriander.
Place the potatoes in a serving dish, pour the seasoning over them with the salt and a little milk, and mix well.
